title: Quantile co-movement and dependence between energy-focused sectors and artificial intelligence
summary: The paper studies links between artificial intelligence and eight energy-focused sectors. The performance of energy-focused corporations, especially in renewable energy, depends strongly on the performance of AI.
keyFindings: Renewable energy firms in particular are strongly tied to AI performance.
Dependence varies across energy sectors, market conditions and investment horizons.
The dependence became stronger during the first wave of the COVID-19 pandemic.
methods: Quantile regressions and quantile cross-spectral coherency models.
